key.name: island-style
key.description: "attached" hangs the island from the top bar like a notch; "floating" is a pill below it.

key.name: open-on-hover
key.description: Expand the island while the pointer rests on it.

key.name: show-when-idle
key.description: Keep a small pill visible when no activity is active.

key.name: vertical-offset
key.description: Distance between the bottom of the top bar and the floating island, in pixels.

key.name: animation-style
key.description: Spring preset used when the island morphs.

key.name: enable-media
key.description: Show media from MPRIS players as a live activity.

key.name: enable-osd
key.description: Show volume, microphone and brightness changes in the island instead of the stock OSD.

key.name: enable-battery
key.description: Show charging, unplugged, full and low-battery notices in the island.

key.name: enable-bluetooth
key.description: Show Bluetooth devices connecting and disconnecting.

key.name: enable-network
key.description: Show Wi-Fi, wired and VPN connections and disconnections.
